data.desc: DigitalOcean (NYSE: DOCN) is the AI-Native Cloud, purpose-built for the inference and agentic era. One integrated platform spans GPU and CPU infrastructure, core cloud, inference, data, learning, and managed agents. It is open throughout so builders can start fast, scale production AI workloads, and improve unit economics. More than 680,000 customers and millions of developers globally trust DigitalOcean to build, ship, and scale their applications. Learn more at digitalocean.com.
